description: This file contains functions and constants for rendering usage details, including session summaries, time series visualizations, context breakdowns, and session logs in a web UI, utilizing lit-html for rendering.

methods.name: pct
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of part over total, handling zero or negative totals.

methods.name: normalizeLogTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to milliseconds, handling seconds vs milliseconds.

methods.name: filterLogsByRange
methods.description: Filters session logs by a timestamp range.

methods.name: renderSessionSummary
methods.description: Renders a summary of a usage session, including message counts, tool usage, and model info.

methods.name: computeFilteredUsage
methods.description: Aggregates usage statistics from time series points within a specified timestamp range.

methods.name: renderSessionDetailPanel
methods.description: Renders a detailed view panel for a session, including summary, time series, logs, and context breakdown.

methods.name: renderTimeSeriesCompact
methods.description: Renders a compact time series chart with interactive range selection and breakdown options.

methods.name: renderContextPanel
methods.description: Displays a breakdown of context tokens by system, skills, tools, and files.

methods.name: renderSessionLogsCompact
methods.description: Displays session logs with filtering, expand/collapse, and timeline filtering.
